biography.plain_text: Sir Timothy Landon was a Canadian-born military officer, Omani brigadier and adviser to Sultan Qaboos. After intelligence service in Dhofar, he remained a trusted foreign-affairs counsellor through successive decades. He became one of Britain's wealthiest private figures, building a large fortune from his Omani advisory career, extensive landholdings and diversified investments.

long_biography.plain_text:
Intelligence work in Dhofar made Timothy Landon a central participant in the 1970 transfer of power that brought Sultan Qaboos to the throne. The cavalry officer then helped coordinate the counter-insurgency, urged the training of Omani officers and advised on development in education, medicine and infrastructure.

Promoted to brigadier in the Sultan's Armed Forces, Landon was later accredited as a counsellor at Oman's London embassy and remained the Sultan's foreign-affairs adviser until his death. His honorary KCVO followed the 1982 state visit. At Faccombe in Hampshire, he supported chamber opera and young musicians, pursued conservation and installed an early wind turbine on the estate.

uncertainties.detail: The official London Gazette confirms James Timothy Whittington Landon, resolving the saved field-parsing error despite The Guardian obituary's apparent use of John as the first name. The saved record and common reference sources give 6 July 2007 as his death date, while The Guardian prints 7 July. No date correction is proposed because the existing value is supported and the discrepancy is immaterial to the biography.

The regimental journal and The Guardian strongly establish Canadian citizenship, so Canadian is proposed as a secondary nationality alongside the saved British value. Sources variously say Vancouver and Vancouver Island; because they do not establish whether the city or broader island is intended, place_of_birth remains blank rather than resolving the discrepancy by assumption. References to Omani nationality are not strong enough for an additional proposal.

Reliable sources agree that Landon's fortune arose during and after his profitable Oman advisory career and became materially tied to property and land. Public evidence does not disclose a complete asset schedule or cleanly separate fees, gifts, commissions and investment returns. Service, Real Estate, Self-made — advantaged start and Investor are therefore conservative reasoned classifications, each scored at medium confidence.

The 1970 transfer of power and Dhofar intelligence work are included because they are indispensable to Landon's defining public role and are directly supported by his regimental history and major reporting. Later allegations concerning arms commissions, sanctions breaches or improper payments are excluded from published prose because they are unnecessary to the durable profile and were not adjudicated in the sources reviewed.

The existing Wikipedia page is an exact-person match and is retained without duplicate proposal. Forbes-first and targeted LinkedIn, Instagram, personal-site and broader social searches found no attributable personal account appropriate for this deceased, notably private subject; no social link is proposed.

Military officer is the sole active tag whose semantic contract is directly and substantially satisfied.
